rules: Display branding is configurable; stable IDs, API paths, database names, tenant identities and persisted data must not be derived from mutable display names.
Render product labels through the shared branding configuration; no hardcoded product labels in future application code.
A display-name change must not require migrations or invalidate sessions, credentials or integrations.
project_id is stable after installation; it is not a display-name variable.
Resolve nonempty environment override before file default. Empty string is invalid.
Expose only the resolved public display configuration to the frontend through the backend; process.env is not a Vite runtime config.
If PROJECT_NAME is the only name override, application_name and display_name inherit it unless independently overridden.
Missing public domain/logo/contact blocks public publication, not local application build; local uses explicit development placeholders.
